image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a brown butterfly, identified as a ringlet (Aphantopus hyperantus), resting on dry vegetation. The wings are held closed, displaying the ventral surface which is light brown with distinct white-ringed eyespots (ocelli) and faint banding. The body is fuzzy/hairy and brown. Antennae are visible and appear clubbed at the tips.
